_comment: The Grade 2 Global Perspectives standalone lesson build, described for ../../mathematics/lesson-app-tools and built by ../lesson-kit. Order here IS the lesson number. Eight lessons organised by the six skills of Cambridge Primary Global Perspectives 0838 Stage 2 (18 objectives), each anchored on one topic a six-to-seven-year-old can talk about, NOT by the units of the Word-pack course under global-perspectives/grade-2/data, so progress is written under l01..l08 - see THE UNIT PROBLEM in wire-progress.py. objectiveFloors are recorded at the measured value after each build and may rise, not fall.
subject: global-perspectives
hubStrands: Asking focused questions about the thing we want to find out; finding the part of a picture or a text that tells us; interviewing classmates to find information and opinions; and recording what we found in pictograms, tables and charts.

Knowing that different people know different things about a topic; seeing that pictures, bars and numbers can all show information; thinking about what our actions do to OTHER people; and suggesting something we could do about a problem of our own.
Suggesting the sources that would help with a topic, and saying why; and saying what we think about a topic with reasons.
Saying which IDEA was ours and which was a friend's when a team finished a job; saying what we learned in an activity; and saying which part helped us learn.
Carrying out our own job so the team's work gets done; and working positively with others towards something we all made.
Giving a short talk about a topic where everything said is about it; and listening to others, then asking a simple, relevant question about what they said.
